senses.gloss: m. (redupl. of קטט, with formative ון; cmp. קִטְקֵט, a. קַטִּין II) pettiness, narrowness.
units: <cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 15:2">Lev. R. s. 15</cite>, beg. (ref. to <cite ref="Job 28:25">Job XXVIII, 25</cite>) as people say, <he>איש פלוני רוחו קצרה … רוח ק׳</he> this man has a narrow spirit (is selfish), for a spirit of pettiness has been put into him; [Ar. has <cite ref="S00839"><he>קטריטון</he></cite>, ed. Koh. <cite ref="S00842"><he>קטרקון</he></cite>, and a different version]; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 916:2">Yalk. Job 916</cite> <he>קטק׳</he> (<cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 554:1">Yalk. Lev. 554</cite> <he>רוח קצרה</he>).
